completion:
If all tests pass, record the final passing test and finalize the test.
3. If a test fails, record that test and try again.
4. If a subsequent test passes, change the passage_initial to that measurement which was passed.
5. Repeat steps 3 - 4 until all measured values are recorded, and then finalize the test.

You can see an example of the algorithm on this [test](https://braememounting.com/api/v1/tests/79df6837-b6e1-4e64-8201-9 hekt)?select=.*).
